items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I never have known a musician in my life that would play all the notes every night, do his job very musicianly and very together

ctx.x:
You can't beat that. I never have known a musician in my life that would play all the notes every night, do his job very musicianly and very together because his background is such that he couldn't be any other way.

He's a graduate of Cincinnati Conservatory, from there he went to the Naval Academy band, he stayed for three or four years, before he ever got into the band field and popular music. And then to take over the responsibilities and come up with the batting average he has, it's just unbelievable.
He does everything from soup to nuts for you, doesn't he?
